subject: Intro from Mahendra | Working w Cedars-Sinai & Caresyntax
text:
Hi [NAME] and Hillary,

Mahendra suggested I connect with you regarding [COMPANY]'s AI/ML initiatives
for Canopy, Remy, and patient billing data.

Encord
<[LINK]>
is a HIPAA-certified multimodal AI data platform that enables ML teams at
Thinking Machine Labs, Veriff and Flatiron Health to curate, label, and
build workflows at scale. Given your security requirements, our platform
ensures PII never leaves your environment by streaming data directly from
your infrastructure.

I believe Encord can support your current projects by:

   - Curating medical billing data from SFTP, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake for
   ML training.
   - Building evaluation workflows for Remy and Kora.
   - Accelerating data preparation for predictive models, such as patient
   notification timing.

Are you open to a brief chat next week to learn how your peers in regulated
environments utilize Encord?
